motions.item_title: Approve the April 21, 2020 minutes. Board Member Curtis seconded The motion. Those voting aye: J…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve the April 21, 2020 minutes. Board Member Curtis seconded The motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: April 21 minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board signed off on the written record of its April 21, 2020 meeting.
motions.impact: This one touches the recorder's files and nobody else. It makes the April meeting's written account the official version.

motions.item_title: Adjourn the meeting at 10:43 p.m. Board Member Burnham seconded the motion. Those voting aye: J…
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to adjourn the meeting at 10:43 p.m. Board Member Burnham seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Meeting adjourned at 10:43 p.m.
motions.summary: The agency board ended its June 2 meeting at 10:43 p.m.
motions.impact: Nothing here reaches a resident. It is the clock stopping on a meeting whose business was already finished.
